partnershipPlan: Two resident representatives review the consent form and video rules; the coaches meet them at mid-year.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I would film every case for coaching, but not if the video ends up in my assessment file.
items.implication: Keep study videos out of assessment and delete them after rating.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Two hours a month is what I can give; edited videos make that possible.
items.implication: Edit videos to the critical steps.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I do not mind being filmed if it helps them learn, as long as nobody can see my face.
items.implication: Use the hospital's training-video consent and keep no identifiable images.

summary: Three composite voices on assessment fears, coach time and patient consent to filming.
